title: Sitar Hero - Forever

html:
Quest Giver: QuestGiver_A

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Kill the two Sitar Heroes in the Mutanous Malaise, Level 2, and the two Sitar Heroes in the Mutanous Malaise, Level 6. Afterward, return to Gee Dubya Shrub in the Mutanous Malaise Mezzanine.

Quest Reward: Gold and 2 King's Coins

Return to: QuestGiver_A

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: The Mutanous Malaise

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Kill the two Sitar Heroes in the Mutanous Malaise, Level 2, and the two Sitar Heroes in the Mutanous Malaise, Level 6. Afterward, return to Gee Dubya Shrub in the Mutanous Malaise Mezzanine.

Offer:

Well, it looks like playing Sitar Hero on Co-Op is all the rage. We can't take down these creatures fast enough before they respawn and just keep on rocking. Get into the Mutanous Malaise and take down these Sitar Heroes!

You will be able to find two of the Sitar Heroes in Mutanous Malaise, Level 2, and the other two Sitar Heroes are in Level 6. When you have dealt with all of them return to me, Gee Dubya Shrub, here in the Mutanous Malaise Mezzanine.

Turn-in:

Well done. Let me know if you want to get back in there and do it again.

Objectives:

  • Pure_Hour_of_Rock_Power
  • Hand_Solo6333

Client level range: 37–55
